introduction: A tween changes values over time. gsap.to starts from the current value and moves toward the value you give it. Your task: Change the distance to 60.
learningObjectives: Explain the example for move to a new position

blocks.text: A tween changes values over time. gsap.to starts from the current value and moves toward the value you give it.
Use a browser project with GSAP 3 installed. Each example creates its own small box. Run one example at a time with a module build tool. GSAP is not loaded by this site's plain runner.
Read the code step by step

items: `textContent` reads or replaces plain text inside an element. It does not interpret the supplied words as HTML.
`createElement` makes a new element in memory. Append it to the document when you want it to appear.
`to` moves from the current values toward the values you supply. GSAP duration values are in seconds.

blocks.text: The box moves 120 CSS pixels to the right over one second.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Duration is in seconds, not milliseconds. Keep the movement useful rather than distracting.
